capabilities: Draw electronic circuits with connected wires
Export schematics to SVG or PNG via clipboard
Store circuit data in a JSON code block
extras: Obsidian plugin is desktop-only and needs Obsidian 1.13.4+; the same project also ships a standalone web editor (browser-local storage, JSON import/export) and an embeddable library. Web formula rendering loads MathJax from jsDelivr and needs a network connection.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw and edit electronic circuit schematics with connected wires and editable symbols inside a note.
summary: Lightweight schematic editor that draws electronic circuits with wires, symbols, labels, and notes, storing data as JSON in the note.
